content: A Knowledge room can be created once vectorization works: configure an embeddings provider in the AI settings.

comment.text: Tooltip over the greyed-out Knowledge room option in the New room chooser of the AI rooms section, shown to a portal owner or Full admin while vectorization (turning files into searchable embeddings for the AI chat) is not working; tells them to configure an embeddings provider in the AI settings. Knowledge room is a room type name.
